postings.description:
About EnergyHub

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

About the Opportunity 

EnergyHub seeks an Associate General Counsel to join its expanding legal team. EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future by helping consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power. The Associate General Counsel will work hand-in-hand with EnergyHub’s business leaders and technical teams to help the company continue its high growth rate and achieve its goal of a carbon-free, distributed energy future. 

The Associate General Counsel will work with teams across EnergyHub to provide advice on a wide range of legal matters, including commercial contracts and transactions, privacy, IP, compliance, M&A, and regulatory issues as well as general corporate matters. The legal team supports all aspects of EnergyHub’s business operations, including commercial relationships, intellectual property, and strategic activities. If you’re excited about interacting with all aspects of a high-growth software business and being on the cutting edge of climate tech, this might be the job for you.

Main Responsibilities: What you'll do

- Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of agreements for EnergyHub, including software, technology, services, vendor, reseller, manufacturer, licensing, marketing and other commercial contracts. A significant portion of time in this position will be spent working with leading companies in the demand response, climate tech, Internet of Things, renewable energy, and utility sectors, and partnering with EnergyHub’s internal teams to define a broad legal and risk management strategy and develop creative solutions to legal issues involved with deploying its industry-leading software platform.

- Advise and provide guidance on a broad scope of legal issues relating to commercial terms, compliance, privacy, security, and regulatory matters

- Work closely with executive, sales, IT, product, and other business teams to provide general legal advice and support and assist in scaling legal and business processes

- Work collaboratively with the EnergyHub/Alarm.com legal team and manage legal staff

- Develop and drive compliance policies and procedures designed to enhance regulatory and business standards compliance and support the company’s business and strategic objectives

- Supervise and coordinate with outside counsel as necessary

- Manage internal paralegal resources as necessary

- Other duties as assigned 

Required Skills and Experience: What you need 

- 5+ years relevant experience in an in-house or large law firm environment, with software, technology industry experience. Familiarity with one or more of the following areas a plus: commercial contracts, public utilities, IP, data and privacy or other regulatory frameworks

- Significant experience negotiating, drafting and reviewing broad range of commercial contracts and familiarity with a wide range of legal matters including corporate, commercial, privacy, IP, regulatory, and compliance issues; demonstrated ability/interest in becoming a corporate generalist

- Team player with a high level of professionalism and commitment to developing strong relationships with colleagues, internal clients, and business teams across the enterprise. 

- Ability to work under pressure, juggle multiple projects with competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to change within a growing company

- Experience with, and enthusiasm for, process improvement, and problem solving

- Superior interpersonal and written and oral communication skills

- Proven organizational, analytical, and negotiation skills with exceptional attention to detail

- Highly skilled in standard office software and ability to adapt quickly to new technologies

- J.D. from a leading law school

- Membership in or eligibility for admission to the New York Bar

- Willingness to travel to Alarm.com’s HQ in the Washington, DC area on an occasional basis

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

- Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.

- Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!

- Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.

- Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs.

postings.title: Client Success Manager
postings.description:
EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. Our customers are real utilities managing the real electrical grid supporting the normal lives of millions of real people. Our mission is to keep the grid running reliably while enabling more renewable energy and reducing reliance on fossil fuel.

Client Success Manager

EnergyHub’s Client Success team launches and operates best-in-class programs for utilities, helping them address grid challenges by engaging customers with connected devices. As a Client Success Manager, helping our clients achieve their goals is your mandate. You will own the client relationship end-to-end, including supporting the launch of our programs, building and maintaining strong client relationships, and serving as a trusted partner to your clients and our sales, product, engineering and marketing teams to maintain account health.

This is a highly visible, client facing role, ideal for someone who has a passion for working with clients and software products, enjoys solving complex challenges, and is curious about the energy distribution systems that power our daily lives. The successful candidate is a quick learner and self-starter, has the ability to communicate a variety of data driven messages to varying audiences, can build relationships effortlessly, is client-focused, and consistently achieves results. 

What you’ll do 

- Be a Client Success advocate: Manage multi-faceted programs with device partners, clients and internal teams. Ensure day-to-day program operations are seamless and client goals and needs are top of mind for the organization. 

- Be a trusted advisor who helps clients achieve their goals: Manage internal expectations as well as those of your clients and prioritize program tasks/activities using business judgment to balance internal objectives with client goals. Spend time understanding and driving clients’ objectives and growth targets and guiding them through key decisions to design programs that support these targets. Partner with Sales to support successful renewals and expansions in your clients’ accounts. Creatively problem-solve when difficult situations arise and resolve operational challenges.

- Be an effective communicator and storyteller: Analyze and present key results, facilitate meetings, and deliver nuanced technical and data driven messages to clients. Maintain consistent and frequent communication with an array of stakeholders including clients and device partners to ensure efficient program implementation, review ongoing needs, and provide timely solutions and recommendations to help achieve program success.

- Be a product and service expert: Develop a comprehensive knowledge of demand management, Distributed Energy Resources, and the drivers of program success. Foster a deep understanding of the product, service offerings and functionality to effectively communicate capabilities to clients, shape program design and provide training to client program teams. 

The ideal candidate will have:

- Experience working in or with renewable energy, utilities, grid services or adjacent industries ( cleantech / greentech) preferred

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to describe complex and technical topics in an engaging and succinct manner

- Demonstrated success working directly with clients 

- Project management experience with the ability to multitask, hit deadlines, and think through risk and dependencies

- An analytical, yet creative and curious mind, with a confident approach to numbers and spreadsheets

- The ability to build trust and outstanding client and partner relationships

- Good judgment in a business context

- Experience working with a team in a cross-functional environment

- Experience managing multiple high-priority projects and the ability to make multi-tasking look effortless

- A BS or BA degree

- At least 3-5 years of professional experience in technology services or customer success with a strong preference for experience within a SaaS or enterprise software-related field 

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with EVs, batteries, connected devices, IOT, or building automation

- Familiarity with Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs and initiatives

- Certifications in energy management, project management, program management

postings.title: Energy Data Scientist
postings.description:
EnergyHub is working to enable a carbon-free, distributed energy future by seamlessly integrating enormous numbers of energy devices with the electric power grid. Our platform coordinates and collects terabytes of data from what will soon be more than 1,000,000 distributed energy devices, such as thermostats, electric vehicles and home batteries. 

Coordinating and evaluating the performance of all of these devices to forecast and estimate the delivered grid value requires state-of-the-art data science, control systems and machine learning. As such, EnergyHub seeks to hire an Energy Data Scientist to join EnergyHub’s Analytics Engineering team. As an Energy Data Scientist you will work closely with other data scientists and analytics engineers to improve the models used for evaluation of our control algorithms. You will collaborate with the Data Science and Power Systems Intelligence team to understand the algorithms and optimizations used in order to improve our performance evaluation and forecasting abilities. You will also contribute to our data management software systems and will become core to the foundation of a future with carbon-free and distributed energy. 

What you will do:

- You will drive the development of M&V methodologies and data science models for more accurate and transparent evaluation of our advanced grid services from fleets of distributed energy resources.

- You will write production-level code, prototype new data products, and apply machine learning algorithms to energy IoT data

- You will work to translate data from one of the largest distributed energy datasets in the electricity industry into actionable insights for electric utilities and other energy industry stakeholders

- You will collaborate closely with stakeholders inside and outside of EnergyHub including Data Engineering, Client Success, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Market Development teams.

- Other duties as assigned

Who you are:

- You are passionate about enabling a carbon-free, distributed energy future

- You thoroughly enjoy finding valuable insights in large, complex datasets

- You have experience with Python and the scientific stack (pandas, numpy, scipy)

- You have proficiency in SQL and understand good data modeling practices (basic ETL/ELT)

- You have a practical comprehension of basic machine learning algorithms and are familiar with popular software packages such as Sklearn and Tensorflow.

- You can explain results from large-scale data analyses to diverse audiences in a way that is clear, interesting and actionable

- You can have fun while working on really hard problems with really smart people

Bonus points if:

- You have experience in the measurement and verification (M&V) of control and optimization of distributed energy resources

- You have experience in using Snowflake, dbt and understanding analytics engineering development practices

- You have experience with at least one BI tool such as Sigma, Tableau, Looker, etc)

- You have experience with scaling data science products in the cloud (e.g., Databricks, AWS, GCP, Azure)

- You have a strong background in mathematics and statistics 

- You have power systems expertise, including three-phase distribution network modeling

postings.title: Head of Strategic Finance
postings.description:
Head of Strategic Finance

About the opportunity
As our Head of Strategic Finance, you will build and lead EnergyHub’s dedicated FP&A and Strategic Finance team, serving as the key forward-looking financial co-pilot to our CEO and executive leadership team in partnership with the FP&A Manager. As an independent subsidiary business of Alarm.com, we have been a part of a public company reporting environment for the past decade, though have been largely operating with a centralized G&A function at the Alarm.com level. As we transition toward a decentralized model, you will play a critical role in establishing dedicated financial strategy, planning, and operational analytical capabilities for EnergyHub.

You will own financial reporting & analysis, short- and long-term financial forecasting, SaaS unit economics, cash flow modeling, capital allocation, and commercial deal analysis in close partnership with our Controller as well as Alarm.com’s corporate FP&A, Treasury, and Investor Relations leaders. This is a senior leadership role requiring operational execution while combining high-level strategic influence, cross-functional partnership, and team management with deep quantitative rigor in a rapidly scaling clean-tech SaaS environment.

What you'll do

Team Leadership & Operational FP&A

- Lead and Grow the FP&A Team: Manage, mentor, and develop EnergyHub’s FP&A team, fostering a high-performance culture grounded in analytical rigor, data quality, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

- Financial Review & Close Oversight: Serve as a key business reviewer within the monthly and quarterly close processes, validating significant transactions for financial accuracy, appropriate business context, and alignment with forecast and management reporting expectations.

- Budget Planning & Forecasting: Lead annual budgeting, quarterly re-forecasting, and long-range strategic planning processes, developing scalable three-statement financial models that adapt dynamically to business needs.

- Performance Analysis & Reporting: Oversee the monthly and quarterly variance analyses (actuals vs. forecast, month-over-month horizontal analysis), translating financial outcomes into strategic operational narrative for executive leadership.

- Corporate & IR Alignment: Coordinate closely with Alarm.com Corporate FP&A and Investor Relations to support public reporting cadences, consolidated forecasting, capital requests, and executive presentations.

Strategic Partnership & Data-Driven Optimization

- Commercial Decision Support & Pricing: Partner with commercial teams (Sales, Client Success, Partner Solutions, Product) to evaluate revenue model optimizations, contract structures, custom deal terms, and pricing strategies to improve lifetime value and profitability.

- Capital Allocation & ROI Analysis: Enable disciplined capital allocation decisions across decision forums, performing scenario modeling, stress testing, and ROI evaluations for key growth initiatives, product roadmap investments, and potential strategic expansion.

- SaaS & Unit Economics Metrics: Establish, track, and optimize business unit KPIs (ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, Gross Margins, Net Retention) and deliver concise, actionable reporting packages for internal stakeholders and board review.

- Process Efficiency & Analytics: Continually evaluate internal financial planning tools and reporting infrastructure, leveraging technology, business intelligence platforms, and automation to streamline analytical workflows and drive cross-functional alignment.

- Other duties as assigned. 

About You

- 12+ years of progressive financial analysis, strategic finance, or FP&A experience within high-growth B2B SaaS or technology companies, with demonstrated experience managing and developing finance teams.

- Quantitative Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative major (Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field) required; Master’s/MBA preferred. Professional certifications such as CPA, CFA, or similar relevant credentials are highly valued and will distinguish candidates.

- Financial Modeling & Technical Mastery: Advanced expertise in multi-year financial modeling, SaaS unit economics, cash flow forecasting, and US GAAP fundamentals.

- Advanced Data Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modeling, database analysis, and BI tools; familiarity with SQL, Python, or data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI) is a strong plus.

- Strategic Communicator: Exceptional executive presentation skills with a proven ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear narrative insights for senior leaders and corporate partners.

- Cross-Functional Partner: Comfortable operating across organizational boundaries—moving fluidly between high-level executive strategy and rolling up your sleeves alongside operational teams.

- Unflappable & Solution-Oriented: Calm and clear-headed under tight deadlines and changing priorities; proactive in identifying risks and unlocking revenue or margin opportunities.

postings.title: Launch Program Manager - Contract
postings.description:
EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. Our customers are utilities managing a complex electrical grid, supporting the daily lives of millions of people.

Our Implementation Services team is seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the launch of new programs and integrations with our utility clients. This role will facilitate the onboarding of utility customers for thermostat, battery, and EV programs that enable flexibility at all levels of the grid. The Program Manager will work in close partnership with our Client Success, Partner Solutions, Marketing, and Engineering teams.

This is an execution-focused engagement for a strong program manager with experience in the energy sector and a proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional launches.

postings.description:
EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. Our customers are real utilities managing the real electrical grid supporting the normal lives of millions of real people. Our mission is to keep the grid running reliably while enabling more renewable energy and reducing reliance on fossil fuel.

Team Lead - Client Success 

EnergyHub’s Client Success team launches and operates best-in-class programs for utilities, helping them address grid challenges by engaging customers with connected devices. As a Team Lead - Client Success, helping our clients and your team achieve their goals is your mandate. You will own the client relationship end-to-end, including supporting the launch of our programs, building and maintaining strong client relationships, and serving as a trusted partner to your clients and our sales, product, engineering and marketing teams to maintain account health.

This is a highly visible, client facing role, ideal for someone who has a passion for working with clients and software products, enjoys solving complex challenges, and is curious about the energy distribution systems that power our daily lives. The successful candidate is a quick learner and self-starter, has the ability to communicate a variety of data driven messages to varying audiences, can build relationships effortlessly, is client-focused, and consistently achieves results. This position requires a player-coach leadership style with direct contributions balanced by tactical leadership of a team. 

What you’ll do 

- Own success for your region. Take responsibility for the Northeast regions’ P&L by driving revenue, managing ARR to meet or exceed company targets, developing and implementing strategies to grow accounts for long-term value and client satisfaction, and serving as the first escalation point for client issues to ensure timely and effective resolution.

- Drive results and strategy. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop and execute strategic initiatives that drive growth and efficiency within the Northeast, lead cross-functional projects and initiatives to ensure alignment with overall company goals and objectives, manage and develop team members while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, and promote excellent people management and leadership through weekly one-to-one meetings, holistic performance management, and creating an environment where high performers can thrive and grow in their careers.

- Model leadership in the business. Oversee a team of Client Success Managers, helping the team manage launches and multi-faceted programs with device partners, clients, and internal teams. Ensure program operations are seamless and client goals and success metrics are top of mind for the organization. Work with Sales to design new program structures to meet client requirements and identify new (and improve existing) tools, processes and best practices. Track and drive renewals and upsell efforts. Develop and report on key metrics of utility programs with internal teams. Foster a collaborative, proactive, problem-solving, high-performance culture within the Client Success team.

Spend time to understand client objectives and help the team guide clients through key decisions to design programs that support these targets. Be an escalation point when difficult situations arise and help the team resolve operational challenges. Support Product and Marketing in capturing the voice of the customer and market feedback. Develop and execute strategies to meet or exceed financial targets by managing the ARR for your region.

- Be an effective communicator. Work with your team to present key results, facilitate meetings, and deliver nuanced messages to clients. Maintain consistent communication with an array of stakeholders to ensure efficient program implementation across the portfolio, review ongoing needs, and provide timely solutions and recommendations to help achieve program success. Foster effective decision-making and operational excellence by building relationships and helping internal teams understand priorities and business context.

- Be a product and service expert. Develop a comprehensive knowledge of demand management, the drivers of program success, and a deep understanding of the product to effectively communicate capabilities to clients and shape program design. Actively contribute to the refinement and development of new product features and service offerings. Support contract negotiations between EnergyHub and utility clients, SOW negotiations with partners and development for end-use customers.

- Other duties as assigned.

- Experience working in or with renewable energy, utilities, grid services or adjacent industries ( cleantech / greentech) required

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to describe complex and technical topics in an engaging and succinct manner

- Demonstrated success working directly with a portfolio clients and programs

- Project management experience with the ability to multitask, hit deadlines, and think through risk and dependencies

- An analytical, yet creative and curious mind, with a confident approach to numbers and spreadsheets

- The ability to build trust and outstanding client and partner relationships

- Good judgment in a business context

- Experience working with a team in a cross-functional environment

- Experience managing multiple high-priority projects and the ability to make multi-tasking look effortless

- A BS or BA degree

- At least 7-10 years of professional experience in technology services or customer success with a strong preference for experience within a SaaS or enterprise software-related field 

- Willingness to travel (~25%)
